name: adr183-continuation-native-30
result: The owned kind network fixed the fixture setup: the fixture rolled out and the bootstrap chain passed. The real API server then rejected the generated EvidenceStoragePool CRD: 'properties[capacityAssurance].type: Required value'. The contract's enum had no type, which a structural schema needs. The generator now infers the type of enum-only nodes and refuses any untyped structural property.
scope: Real kind API, OpenBao, SeaweedFS S3 and PostgreSQL; the continuation subtest stopped at CRD installation.
